question: Who imports HS 2102.20.10 (yeast of a kind used in animal feeding) and 2102.20.90, in what tonnage, 2024 to 2026?
why_it_matters: Names T2 buyers and splits feed from food in the 9,200 t pool; three or more ASC mills each importing 500 t or more would meet the market-pull rubric of 5; mostly food or pet food would cut it to 3
cheapest_way_to_close: Declaration-level customs extract for 2102.20 by importer and description (extend DMV-02)
owner_org_to_ask: General Department of Customs; a trade-data vendor; Vietnam Animal Feed Association

question: Which yeast products do Vietnamese shrimp and pangasius mills use, at what dose and price, and what gain do they measure?
why_it_matters: Turns the inferred price-per-performance hurdle (1.2 to 1.8% of shrimp-feed cost) into a stated or tested one; sets the head-to-head trial design
cheapest_way_to_close: Three structured calls with nutritionists at Grobest, Skretting Vietnam, De Heus (Vinh Long marine R&D centre) and Sheng Long
owner_org_to_ask: Grobest; Skretting Vietnam; De Heus Vietnam; Sheng Long

question: What happened in Grobest's evaluation of bacterial single-cell protein (species, product, inclusion, result, price)?
why_it_matters: The only disclosed microbial-protein test by a leading Vietnamese shrimp-feed maker; a negative on price or performance is the closest thing to a T2 kill-test result
cheapest_way_to_close: Written question to Grobest's sustainability or R&D team

question: Would BAP count yeast or bacterial biomass grown on sugar as an ingredient from "other aquatic microorganisms" under Feed Mill Standard clause 4.6 (Amendment 1)?
why_it_matters: Decides whether T2 or T3 products earn credit towards BAP's 75% marine-ingredient target, or only microalgae do
cheapest_way_to_close: One email to the Global Seafood Alliance standards team

question: How much spent brewer's yeast and amino-acid fermentation biomass is produced in Vietnam, and where does it go now?
why_it_matters: The revealed price (about USD 1.1 per kg) is set by by-product yeasts; a domestic by-product stream is the only T2 route that can meet it
cheapest_way_to_close: Company sustainability reports and direct questions (links to OQ-017 and OQ-018)
owner_org_to_ask: Heineken Vietnam; Sabeco; Vedan; Ajinomoto Vietnam

question: Who exports the 8,166 t of HS 2102.20 that left Vietnam in 2025, and is any of it feed grade?
why_it_matters: Domestic yeast plants are T2's nearest competitors and possible tolling partners
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask AB Mauri Vietnam and Lesaffre (Saf-Viet); exporter-level customs data
owner_org_to_ask: AB Mauri Vietnam; Saf-Viet (Lesaffre); General Department of Customs

question: Will Vinh Hoan's Feed One or another integrated pangasius group sign a trial or offtake for a non-insect microbial ingredient?
why_it_matters: An anchor buyer is what investors and DFIs ask for (wave 7 AIS-Q14); none found
cheapest_way_to_close: Direct approach to Vinh Hoan investor relations and Feed One management
owner_org_to_ask: Vinh Hoan Corporation; Nam Viet; Sao Mai Group
